relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine reduced the magnitude of ExTxA‐evoked responses (0.1 ± 0.01), but not the percentage (27%, 40/146) of responding DRG neurons (Figure 1A,B).

key_findings: ExTxA removes fast inactivation of Nav1.8 when co-expressed with TMEM233, and ExTxA-evoked calcium influx in DRG neurons is nearly abolished by TTX plus suzetrigine.
TMEM233 alone stabilizes inactivated Nav1.8 (shifted fast and slow inactivation, slowed recovery, enhanced use-dependent lidocaine block) across 10, 21 and 37 C.
